NLNK.description: General Link (NLNK). REF_SYSTEM chooses the orientation input: when 0 (Element system) BETA_ANGLE is used; when 1 (Global/User system) INPUT_METHOD selects ANGLE_VALUES (0), POINT_VALUES (1) or VECTOR_VALUES (2).

NODE1.description: ID number of the first connected node (start node) of the general link element.

NODE2.description: ID number of the second connected node (end node) of the general link element.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name the link belongs to. Must reference an existing boundary group; empty string means no group.

PROP_NAME.description: General Link Property name. Must reference an existing NLLP (general link property).

IEHP_NAME.description: Inelastic Hinge Property name. Empty string means none; when set it must reference an existing IEHP (inelastic hinge property).

REF_SYSTEM.description: Reference coordinate system for the element orientation. 0 = Element coordinate system (uses BETA_ANGLE); 1 = uses INPUT_METHOD with ANGLE_VALUES / POINT_VALUES / VECTOR_VALUES.

BETA_ANGLE.description: [REF_SYSTEM=0] Beta angle (degrees) rotating the element coordinate system about its local x-axis.

INPUT_METHOD.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1] Orientation input method. 0 = Angle (uses ANGLE_VALUES); 1 = 3 Points (uses POINT_VALUES); 2 = Vector (uses VECTOR_VALUES).

ANGLE_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=0] Orientation given as angles. One object whose VALUE holds the 3 angles [about x, about y', about z''].

VALUE.description: Three angle components [about x, about y', about z''] in degrees.

POINT_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=1] Orientation given as 3 reference points [P0, P1, P2]. Three objects, each VALUE holding one point [X, Y, Z].

VECTOR_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=2] Orientation given as 2 reference vectors [V1, V2]. Two objects, each VALUE holding one vector [X, Y, Z].

VALUE.description: One vector component set [X, Y, Z].
